shorts_extract.hook: Stopping a charging bull on Page 1 of The New York Times: what José Delgado's 1965 radio 'stimoceiver' really did inside the basal ganglia.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Delgado (1965 Córdoba bull demo) + Valenstein (1973) / Horgan (2005 Scientific American) caudate motor-turning proof + modern Parkinson's DBS.
shorts_extract.twist: Why caudate stimulation steered muscles sideways rather than 'curing anger', why 1969 mind-control hype backfired, and why putting the remote in the patient's hand changed everything.
